device.notes: MR1 send-only. Paste the BotFather bot token in Secret/Token (never logged). Set chat_id to the destination chat (numeric id or @channel). Host field unused — traffic always goes to api.telegram.org over HTTPS. Set NIC face to Venue / outbound so egress uses the room internet NIC (AV face also works on single-NIC hosts). message.send value = plain text (parse_mode off). Authenticate runs getMe. No getUpdates / webhook in this version — inbound commands need a later MR with allowlisted chat_ids + allowlisted macro ids (optional shared PIN in message); never arbitrary shell. Fail-closed if token or chat_id missing.

pairing.userPrompt: Paste BotFather token into Secret/Token, set chat_id, prefer NIC face Venue/outbound, then Authenticate (getMe).
